task: detect whether one numeric evidence token was substituted while the surrounding evidence text remained unchanged
labels: constructed mechanism labels, not human gold labels
calibration: threshold selected on validation by maximum F1, ties resolved toward higher threshold
test_policy: test evaluated once after code and protocol registration
uncertainty: 1000-sample owner-level bootstrap 95% interval for hybrid F1 and AUROC
prohibited_claim: results demonstrate numeric-mutation sensitivity only and are not human-gold accuracy
